scope: Tracked file trees on default main branches accessible to the connected GitHub account. Blob SHA is a file-content snapshot, not runtime certification. Compared the 2026-10-26 inventory with all 24 current main trees on 2026-11-02. This inventory excludes its own file to avoid a self-referential hash; it includes the current forensic map and all other tracked paths. Other accounts, uncommitted changes, and unconnected services remain outside scope.

comparison.note: The Master-System-Buildout reference SHA is the base main commit before this audit PR; the current map and inventory blobs are staged on the audit branch. After merge, this inventory records the merged map blob; the inventory file itself is excluded.
